text: Character sheet + location background generation pipeline built and running (Alex remote, 5090 via Tailscale). Built tools/gen_char_sheet.py (H3 ref2va still + retro-fantasy LoRA @1.05, graph extracted from Oct-18 Juliana regen -> graphs/H3CharSheet_technicolor.json, 12 chars: 8 mains Larn/Jarol/Taro/Roliel/Otwa/Shaitan/Spirit/Tutor + regen Teegra/Juliana/Nekron/Darkwolf) and tools/gen_location_plates.py (Krea2 t2i, empty-scene, retro-fantasy@1.0 person_27 OFF, 21 canonical locations from manifests/locations.json consolidating 50 roster slugs). Larn sheet + jungle plate verified via goldfishbowl qwen3-vl-8b: live-action 80s technicolor, correct layout, no defects. Batch queued on 5090 (12 sheets + 21 plates, serialized). Staged id_<NAME> identity stills for all 12. Merged misspelled JULIANNA dir into JULIANA (roster canonical).

T0015 S05-c01 Track A (REF2VA) test: fed Teegra+Tutor technicolor sheets + fire-keep-study plate as <Picture> refs (ref_image_size=max) + raw 1983 source ref video for motion/audio. RESULT (goldfishbowl qwen3-vl-8b, 3 frames): still reads flat 2D rotoscope cel, NOT live-action. Same failure as FL2VA TEST 1 one stage up — sheets+plates styled but <Video 1> source ref is raw rotoscope and dominates appearance. Consequence: Track A needs the video ref restyled first, or use Track B (text-only, no video ref) / Track C (first/last frame). Driver: runs/build_technicolor_ref2va.py. Also built tools/gen_refs_batch_4090.py (330 stills: 12 chars x10 + 21 locations x10, Krea2 turbo + retro-fantasy on 4090, person_27 OFF, canonical traits) — subagent running it.

Plate QC via goldfishbowl qwen3-vl-32b-heretic (8B was useless, passed everything): 21 plates -> 10 GOOD, 11 BAD (mush/broken perspective + text artifacts on study/map/harbor + roliel-hut leaked a character). Rewrote 11 bad prompts verbose (FG/MG/BG layering, light direction, coherent-perspective, hard 'no text/no watermark/no people' negatives since Krea2 has no negative prompt). Regen 11 as t02 same seed: 10/11 now GOOD. Only darkwolf-camp still BAD (campfire mush, both takes). Next lever for that one: resolution/steps, not prompt length.
Alex: the T0015 video looked good; wants more generated as ref2v WITHOUT the video reference, audio only.

KEY RESULT (T0016): REF2VA AUDIO-ONLY (no <Video 1>, no ref_videos; source audio via ref_audios.ref_audio_0 + audio_vae; technicolor sheets+plate as <Picture>) HOLDS the live-action 80s technicolor register, while the video-ref version (T0015) reads flat 2D rotoscope cel — same frame, only the video ref differs. Confirms the direction-doc hypothesis: the raw rotoscope <Video 1> was what dragged the clip to cel. Audio-only is the working mode. Driver: runs/build_technicolor_audio_only.py (extracts chunk audio to audio-only mp4, uploads, LoadAudio). S05-c01 done (12.25s, 1344x768); c02-c04 queued.

4090 bulk ref batch COMPLETE + verified on disk: 330 stills = 120 character (12 chars x10) + 210 location (21 locations x10), retro-fantasy Krea2 turbo, canonical traits, person_27 OFF. Dir: renders/4090/refs-batch-20261023-134707/. Recovered from subagent death (portal 401 killed the downloader; renders kept flowing in ComfyUI queue; tools/collect_refs_batch.py drained it). Fixed gen_refs_batch_4090.py to skip PreviewImage temp dupes (was downloading 2x).

Blocking bug + fix (S05 audio-only): my prompt builder dropped ALL action beats, so with no video ref H3 invented 'walking toward camera' instead of the real blocking. motion[] only carries 'static' and cannot express 'lounging'. Fix: hand-authored per-chunk blocking in manifests/blocking.json (grounded in the source stills; per the ruling VLM captions are appearance-only), injected at the top of detailed_description; S05 plate changed fire-keep-study -> fire-keep-chamber (it is a royal bedchamber, not a study — verified by viewing the source stills directly). Added --take flag. Re-render t02 verified: t01 = walking to camera, t02 = seated/lounging on the bed in a bedchamber. Driver: runs/build_technicolor_audio_only.py.
